summary.name: Quark (quark.sm.cn)
summary.one_liner: Quark's mobile-oriented web search page at quark.sm.cn, which serves search results and suggestions through a Chinese-language interface.
use_cases: search the web on a phone
look up search suggestions in Chinese
find apps and web results from one search box
summary.what_it_does: The page is the mobile touch-version home screen of Quark's search site, with a search box, query suggestions loaded from a suggestion API, and a local search history of up to six recent queries. Submitting a query sends the user to a search results page on the sm.cn host. The visible text is mostly scripts and footer, with little descriptive content about features. The listing describes Quark as an all-in-one search, browser, and scanner, but the page text itself does not confirm those features.
notable: Mobile touch-optimized search box with query suggestions
Stores up to six recent searches locally
Lightweight page built on Zepto with search-suggestion API
caveats: Page text is mostly code and footer; features beyond search are not described on the page
Interface and results are in Chinese
